# Comparison: LEFT (mockup) vs RIGHT (AI render)

## Pose
- Both: doctor bust, arms crossed, facing forward. **Match.** Left has arms crossed at chest; right similar but hands tucked lower, one fist visible. Minor difference.
- Framing: Left is tighter/bust slightly off; right is centered, larger head-to-body ratio (bigger head, chibi-like). Framing similar but proportions differ.

## Clothing
- White coat: both ✓. Left coat is softer/less defined; right has crisp lapels and collar.
- Shirt: Left shows **blue shirt + dark tie**. Right shows light blue shirt + dark navy tie ✓, though the collar area is more prominent/lighter blue.
- Left also seems to show a faint red/maroon tie hint at the bottom (unclear). Right clearly navy.

## Hair
- Left: dark brown/black, side-parted, fairly flat.
- Right: dark brown, glossy, larger swooping style with more volume. Similar color, more stylized/bulkier than mockup.

## Face
- Left: gentle smile, simple oval face, small eyes.
- Right: larger head, big eyes, rosy cheeks, big ears, wide smile — cuter/more cartoonish ("kawaii" style) than mockup. Overall still friendly, but proportions differ noticeably (oversized head).

## Stethoscope
- Left: black tubing around neck, chest piece low.
- Right: black tube + **silver/metallic dual chest piece**, more prominent and detailed. Close match; right more polished.

## Style
- Left: soft flat-ish 3D cartoon, muted.
- Right: high-gloss 3D clay/Pixar render — significantly shinier and more exaggerated than the mockup.

## Scores

| Criterion | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Silhouette | 0.8 | Same bust/arms-crossed pose; head too large, framing slightly wider |
| Details | 0.8 | Coat, tie, stethoscope all present; oversized ears/cheeks, extra gloss |
| Colors | 0.9 | White coat, blue shirt, navy tie, dark hair all correct; slight blue shift in collar |
| Overall | 0.75 | Recognizable and faithful in content, but style drift (chibi proportions, glossy clay look) |

**Overall ≈ 0.80**

## Brief Fixes
1. Reduce head size ~20–30% toward realistic bust proportions.
2. Tone down gloss/specular highlights; match softer mockup shading.
3. Shrink ears and cheek blush; make eyes smaller.
4. Narrow the framing (tighter crop like mockup).
5. Match hair volume to the flatter side-parted mockup style.
